selected_evidence.requirement: Serve the inventory application over TCP 8181 while mandatory access control remains enforcing
selected_evidence.summary: Apache is enabled and active under httpd_t, listens on 8181, returns HTTP 200 with Inventory Application content, SELinux is Enforcing, port 8181 is labeled http_port_t, content is labeled httpd_sys_content_t, the firewall permits the port, and no boot-time AVC denials were found.

The healthy baseline used boot ID 717db5a2-895d-4bfb-b8a8-d4891c7b7b01; the restart was acknowledged; the recovered node reported changed boot ID dcbfd90a-04c2-4528-9076-607f3e2c6165; system health, SELinux enforcement, Apache, listener, firewall, labels, and application data all recovered.
